description: This file defines a React component for managing review sessions in a web application. It includes UI components for listing, creating, editing, and deleting sessions, utilizing hooks for state management and API calls to perform CRUD operations.

methods.name: toFormState
methods.description: Converts a ReviewSession object into a form state object for editing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form data for creating or editing a review session, returning an array of error messages.

methods.name: SessionsPage
methods.description: Main page component that wraps SessionsCrud with authorization and page layout.

methods.name: SessionsCrud
methods.description: Component that manages the list of review sessions with CRUD operations and UI interactions.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads the session list data from the API.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Initializes form state for creating a new session.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Loads an existing session into the form for editing.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating a session, with validation and API calls.
